title: Sensor status change v1
description: A sensor went from one status to another. Published to Kafka topic sensor.status.v1 with the sensor id as key. Delivery is at least once: the same event (same eventId) can arrive more than once.

eventId.description: Identifies the change. Use it to recognise a repeated delivery.

changedAt.description: When the change was noticed, UTC, RFC 3339. Up to one check interval later than when it became true.

lastReadingTs.description: When the sensor's latest reading was taken, as known at the time of the change.

status.description: online: a reading within the last 10 s. degraded: none for 10 s. offline: none for 30 s. (Default thresholds.)
